identity: exact app/test hashes and signing cert
target package/version UID/process PID and instrumentation selector
exact scope and immutable original fixture identity
source: announced length and actual raw EOF/hash/bytes
cumulative physical bytes and original read offsets/count
sourceVersion/epoch and same original Provider identity
per-source/global peaks and no queue bypass
parser: real extractor class, endTracks and actual SeekMap/duration/points
per sample size/PTS/flags/keyframe and declared NAL-representation hash; actual count
parser END_OF_INPUT and replay/end position independent from whole-stream EOF
output: qualified fixture admission before mux create/write
actual payload/EOS count/timing, byte totals and original flush/close/return
real reopened format/six samples/CSD/PTS/size/hash compare policy and actual duration
returns: same original source/FD/registry/read worker and callback return
actual caller/parser/observer threads joined; method deadline not return proof
first failure and SDK lower bounds/physical attempted/UNKNOWN separately
owner strong retention on UNKNOWN; no force stop/second close/refund
classification: Android real operation executed vs host/static review vs NOT_RUN
